Author: Kotanna
Name: Job Profiles
Punchline: Switch HUD layout and run a macro when you change job.
Description: Pick a HUD layout and/or a macro for each role (tanks, healers, melee, crafters…), and override them for single jobs. Whenever your job changes, however you change it, the layout is applied and the macro runs. /jobprofiles opens settings; /jobprofiles apply re-applies the current job's profile.
